Abstract Command

Absolute Address:
Base Offset:
0x5c
Size:
0x4
Source:
debug_module.rdl

Description

Writes cause corresponding abstract command to execute. Writing while busy sets cmderr=1 (if cmderr=0). Ignored if cmderr is non-zero.

Contents

Bits Identifier Access Reset Decoded Name
[31:24] cmdtype rw 0x0 -
[23:0] control rw 0x0 -

Field Descriptions

cmdtype

Type of abstract command (e.g., 0 for Access Register, 1 for Quick Access, 2 for Access Memory).

control

Command-specific control field.
